title: A11y Eval Deprecated: AutoRegisterBug Guard on Use
desc: a11y eval action is REMOVED (hard-blocked). Returns false immediately with [REMOVED] banner + migration hint. MCP path auto-redirects to read --eval-js.
steps: a11y eval is deprecated. When called via CLI directly, prints [DEPRECATED] banner and AutoRegisterBug() fires a BUG-AUTO suggest entry to track callers.

MCP path FIXED 2026-05-07 (commit 59997c34): McpCommand.Helpers.BuildUnifiedArgs now redirects action==eval to [read, target, --eval-js, expression] BEFORE reaching DeprecatedEval. MCP wkappbot tool callers no longer trigger USAGE-DEPRECATED.

To migrate a direct CLI caller: replace a11y eval <hwnd> <expr> with a11y read <grap> --eval-js <expr>. The eval action evaluated JS-like expressions -- use --eval-js with explicit a11y action instead.
If BUG-AUTO USAGE-DEPRECATED reappears after the MCP fix, locate the remaining direct CLI caller via wkappbot file grep a11y-eval --type yaml --type sh.
Verified 2026-05-07: test-mcp-a11y-eval-action-redirected-no-bug-auto.sh confirms MCP redirect at McpCommand.Helpers.cs:177-188.
